title: Mr. Chen Yunchang: A "Street Piano" Performer
description: Join a heartfelt journey in Shenzhen with Xunjing Tang, where music bridges communities. From volunteering with autistic children to learning vibrant street piano artistry from 70-year-old mentor Mr. Chen Yunchang, discover how passion and persistence shape the city’s soul. Witness street melodies uniting generations—proof that romance and resilience coexist in urban artistry.
